findings.finding: Hash-valid byte blobs containing NaN/Infinity/overflow numbers bypass finite JSON write validation when read. RGBA documents miss structured required/version validation; sequence reads admit invalid clock/index/pivot/direction/type/version records.
findings.oracle: All semantic document reads reject malformed/nonfinite values with ValidationError before consumers use them.
findings.required_fix: Strict finite JSON on read and complete version1 RGBA/sequence schema/clock/metadata validation, including structured missing-field errors.

findings.finding: Captured source bytes and decoded pixels can disagree because the file path is reopened after raw capture. A bounded injected path replacement records red PNG bytes but returns green pixels.
findings.oracle: Decode the exact captured byte buffer; verify returned pixels correspond to that artifact, regardless of subsequent path changes.
findings.required_fix: Image.open(BytesIO(raw)) rather than Image.open(path). The injected replacement models the read/open boundary, not an observed user incident.

findings.finding: APNG default-image poster is imported as an extra animation frame with fabricated1/12 duration. The explicit2-frame200/300ms animation becomes3 frames red/green/blue with83.3/200/300ms. Invalid image inputs also escape as decoder exceptions.
findings.oracle: Poster is separately retained, never manufactured timed animation; two real frames retain their clocks. Decoder failures are structured.
findings.required_fix: Explicit default_image/poster handling and finite play-count policy, plus decoder exception conversion.

findings.finding: Missing conditional paint/outline colors/maps and invalid mapping/selector arrays leak KeyError/AttributeError/TypeError. String pixel_perfect and nonfinite view are accepted; zero-height layers can be accepted by selection.
findings.oracle: Validate nested conditional fields, Boolean controls, finite JSON and nonempty layer dimensions before mutation; failures are ValidationError.
findings.required_fix: Preflight typed operation/selector fields and dimensional/resource validation.

findings.finding: Nonobject recipe/canvas and nonarray layers fail as Python AttributeError/TypeError before pinned renderer, rather than structured local validation.
findings.oracle: Malformed envelope yields ValidationError; no candidate/head published.
findings.required_fix: Validate recipe/canvas/layer/image container shapes before get/len/items operations.

findings.finding: Layer copies occur before n*w*h resource validation. The check ignores aggregate layer count. Brush center count bounds are checked after interpolation-list construction; allowed size64×200k centers can entail large nested work.
findings.oracle: Budgets should be checked before expensive copies/construction and account for aggregate layers and footprint work.
findings.tests: test_brush_interpolation_budget_rejects_before_raster_paint is a bounded positive rejection control; no enormous allocation or worst-case paint was executed.
findings.required_fix: Apply aggregate input/copy/work budgets before costly work; do not infer a measured memory or timeout failure from this source-only risk.
